scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve the option to add a youth helmet-fitting station to Saturday’s bike-light clinic if required staffing can be secured.
Emerging Need: A no-cost partner kit becomes available only for sites with two trained fitters named before a roster cutoff; one trained helper is already scheduled, but the second confirmed fitter is missing.
Decision Context: The add-on is not justified before the kit offer, and later family attendance makes it more useful; stored hub records identify the suitable backup and roster-confirmation constraint.
Consequence: If the prerequisite is lined up before allocation closes, the station remains feasible without overpromising; afterward, the clinic can continue but the helmet-fitting benefit is lost.

parameter.title: Saturday Bike-Light Check Clinic
parameter.description: Bike-light checks and reflector handout; helmet fitting is not listed unless a partner kit becomes available.

parameter.subject: Weekend helmet-fit kits
parameter.body: We have a small number of youth helmet-fit kits available for neighborhood clinics this weekend. Sites that add a helmet-fit station need two trained fitters named on the roster by Friday, February 20 at 12:00. Kits not reserved by then will go to school sites. Bike-light tables may run without the station.

parameter.content: I'm still set for Saturday on lights and reflectors only. I won't have the helmet-fit training completed before then.

parameter.title: Saturday Bike-Light Check Clinic
parameter.description: Bike-light checks and reflector handout; youth services table has moved next to the plaza setup, so families with kids are expected around 10:15. Helmet fitting remains unlisted unless a partner kit is secured.

parameter.subject: Helmet-fit kits allocated
parameter.body: The noon roster cutoff has passed, and all unrostered helmet-fit kits have been assigned to school sites. Saturday bike-light tables can still proceed without a helmet station kit.
